title: tylerlum/simtoolreal
abstract:
Official implementation of SimToolReal: An Object-Centric Policy for Zero-Shot Dexterous Tool Manipulation

# SimToolReal: An Object-Centric Policy for Zero-Shot Dexterous Tool Manipulation [Project Page](https://simtoolreal.github.io/) https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e2d0db98-2e31-46aa-9480-c4c6f4a48f7d # Overview This repository is the official implementation of _SimToolReal: An Object-Centric Policy for Zero-Shot Dexterous Tool Manipulation_. It provides: * Simulation environments: Isaac Sim (recommended) and Isaac Gym (legacy) environments for training and evaluating dexterous tool manipulation policies. * DexToolBench: A benchmark for dexterous tool manipulation. * RL training: Reinforcement learning algorithms for training these policies. * Deployment: Policy deployment in simulation and the real world. # Project Structure **External repos:** [FoundationPose](https://github.com/kushal2000/FoundationPose) — Perception system (SAM + FoundationPose pose tracking) # Installation The recommended setup runs SimToolReal in **Isaac Sim** (via Isaac Lab, Python 3.11, pip-installable): see the [IsaacSim Installation](docs/isaacsim_installation.md) documentation. The legacy **Isaac Gym** environment (Python 3.8, manual binary download) is covered in the [IsaacGym Installation](docs/isaacgym_installation.md) documentation. The two environments live in separate venvs (`.venv_isaacsim` and `.venv`) and can coexist. # Quick Start Run all commands from the repository root. Most commands accept `--help` to list available options. ## 1. Download the Pretrained Policy This downloads `config.yaml` and `model.pth` into `pretrained_policy/`. ## 2. Interactive Evaluation on DexToolBench Launch the web-based interactive demo (default `http://localhost:8080`): pick a tool category, object instance, and task from the dropdown menus, then load the environment and run episodes. On the Isaac Gym setup, run `dextoolbench/eval_interactive_isaacgym.py` (same arguments) from the `.venv` environment instead. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/58eb188b-662c-4190-8148-29710c9eb20f #
abstract_zh: SimToolReal 是一种对象中心策略，用于零样本灵巧工具操作。本仓库提供了官方实现，包括基于 Isaac Sim（推荐）和 Isaac Gym（旧版）的仿真环境、DexToolBench 基准测试、强化学习训练算法以及仿真与真实世界的策略部署。外部依赖 FoundationPose 用于感知（SAM + FoundationPose 位姿跟踪）。安装支持 Isaac Sim（通过 Isaac Lab，Python 3.11，pip 安装）和 Isaac Gym（Python 3.8，手动下载二进制文件）。快速开始：下载预训练策略，然后通过交互式演示在 DexToolBench 上评估。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：学习一个以物体为中心的强化学习策略：在 Isaac Sim / Isaac Gym 仿真中用 RL 训练灵巧手操作策略，策略输入以被操作物体的点云/位姿（由 SAM + FoundationPose 感知提供）为核心的物体中心表征而非工具特定的关节或外形编码，从而可零样本迁移到训练中未见过的工具并部署到真机。


# 一、动机

> 灵巧手使用工具（如锤子、螺丝刀、勺子等）的操作策略通常针对特定工具训练，难以泛化到未见过的工具与新物体；该工作希望用「以物体为中心」的表征摆脱对特定工具几何的过拟合，实现对新工具与真实场景的零样本泛化。


# 二、方法

> 学习一个以物体为中心的强化学习策略：在 Isaac Sim / Isaac Gym 仿真中用 RL 训练灵巧手操作策略，策略输入以被操作物体的点云/位姿（由 SAM + FoundationPose 感知提供）为核心的物体中心表征而非工具特定的关节或外形编码，从而可零样本迁移到训练中未见过的工具并部署到真机。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 公开仓库与摘要未给出量化指标（成功率、泛化工具数量等具体数字），主要交付物为：(1) 官方实现与预训练策略（config.yaml + model.pth）；(2) DexToolBench 灵巧工具操作基准，支持按工具类别/实例/任务在网页交互 demo（localhost:8080）中评测；(3) Isaac Sim（推荐，Python 3.11，pip 安装）与 Isaac Gym（legacy，Python 3.8）两套仿真训练/评测环境；(4) 仿真与真实世界的策略部署流程。


# 四、对我的启发

> 启发：以物体为中心的表征是把灵巧操作策略从「单工具专用」推向「零样本通用」的关键设计，配合 SAM+FoundationPose 的通用物体位姿感知，可将「工具」当作任意刚体处理，减少工具特定工程。局限：策略性能上界受感知精度（FoundationPose 位姿跟踪）制约；仓库为工程实现，暂未提供可量化的跨工具/真机成功率对比，零样本泛化的边界（接触丰富、铰接物体等）仍需实验验证。
